notes.title: Update 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
We've updated Flagsplosion adding four new game modes, two new leaderboards, and ten new achievements. We've also included several smaller updates and fixed several bugs.
- Added four new game modes (Canton Mode, Un-Canton Mode, Endless Reverse, and Endless Reverse Hard)
- Added ten new achievements
- Added two new leaderboards (Endless Reverse and Endless Reverse Hard)
- Added count to stars in Practice
- Added more background music
- Updated achievement art
- Updated some in-game graphics
- Fixed bug in Switched Practice flag selection
- Fixed bug with mode name when running out of time in Endless Hard
- Fixed bug with Friends leaderboard
- Fixed bug where it was possible to re-lock Switched Practice

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New patch release with a few fixes:
- Random Training Random Mode will now randomly select the mode each time when clicking "Play New Set"
- Fixed typos in achievement names
- Updated Endless Hard icon
- Endless Hard icon will  now open directly the the Endless Hard leaderboards
- Fixed bug allowing different names for the same flag to show up as options in Endless mode (i.e. Both Romania and Chad will no longer show up as options if either of those flags are shown in Endless, and the same with Indonesia and Monaco)

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added explosions! (So no one can complain anymore that there's no explosions in Flagsplosion)
- Added Random Flag & Type to Random Training levels
- Added note that beating Training levels unlocks flags for Practice Mode
- Leaderboards should now update with new score immediately after earning new score
- Added 16 Malaysian flags and 3 Training levels
- In Stat window, added number of flags in each category
- Score Icon indicates if Endless high score was earned in normal Endless or Endless Hard
- Shows Endless Hard high score while playing Endless Hard
- Normalized some colors

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We just released Version 1.0.3.

1.0.3 Patch Notes:

- Fixed Training Mode achievements not unlocking (If you did not unlock achievements before, complete the highest level you can in Training and the missed achievements should unlock)
- Updated dates for the flag of Austria
- Prevent Indonesia or Monaco from appearing as a choice when the other one is the correct answer

1.0.2 Patch Notes:

- Added arrows to scroll through flags in Stats window manually
- Added button to replay same training mode with a new random set
- Fixed that viewing the Encyclopedia while previewing a random training set would reset the flags used
- Removed two potentially controversial flags


Since I didn't post notes for 1.0.1, here's what changed:

- Added a button to show user's score on the global score list
- Colored the player's name in the Leaderboards list (Friends and Global)
